item.description:

item.title: HyperliquidX 0.1.4
item.description:
HyperliquidX 0.1.4

This update improves trading-session management, order entry, account details and notifications.

  • Added per-wallet trading authorization durations from 1 hour to 6 months, expiry indicators, renewal controls and explicit revocation. Supported Team-signed builds securely save authorizations in the macOS Keychain and restore them with Touch ID or the Mac password. Locking or disconnecting preserves a saved authorization; revocation removes the HyperliquidX authorization at the exchange. Locking or sleeping the Mac suspends local signing.
  • Unified Connect Wallet, Enable Trading and Place Order into one order-entry action. Valid saved authorizations can be unlocked locally. Unavailable sessions open session management and preserve the order draft instead of requesting an order signature from the main wallet.
  • Fixed leverage adjustments that remained in Updating and improved cancellation and panel dismissal while waiting for a signature. Added direct order submission and entry TP/SL inputs with price, percentage and estimated profit/loss calculations.
  • Expanded position and open-order details, including funding since the position opened, protection readouts, original and remaining order quantities, order values and the Time column. Improved alignment and close-order controls.
  • Updated order notifications to use Order Placed and Order Filled ✅ with direction, quantity, token and price. Suppressed duplicate accepted/filled-state banners and reduceOnlyCanceled banners while retaining local records. Kept large-trade direction indicators, compact amounts and weighted average prices.
  • Improved order-book refresh with fast complete snapshots, fallback handling, prepared depth rows and pipeline diagnostics. Charts can pan into future space while retaining the newest candle.
  • Improved saved-wallet selection and reconnect handling, WalletConnect cancellation and readiness checks, and application identity with the HyperliquidX website and logo. Some wallets may still show Unknown origin because the integrated native SDK does not register origin proofs.
  • Moved interface text into English localization resources with generated Swift accessors and release-time consistency checks. Refined session-management layout, button styling, action explanations and the expanded signing-data preview.

The macOS installer supports Apple Silicon and Intel and retains the existing ad-hoc signing policy. It is not Apple notarized. Protected Keychain session recovery requires a stable Team-signed build; ad-hoc releases do not enable that capability. The native-origin verification limitation is independent of the displayed application logo.

item.title: HyperliquidX 0.1.3
item.description:
HyperliquidX 0.1.3

This patch improves the order book, recent trades, market notifications and wallet visibility.

  • Added order book price grouping and a switch between token and quote-currency units for Size and Total. Quote totals use each level's price, and changing grouping clears stale quotes while preserving the chart.
  • Unified order book and Recent trades price formatting so prices retain trailing zeros at the displayed precision.
  • Added Hyperliquid Explorer links for recent trades with valid transaction hashes, token labels for trade sizes, and improved column alignment.
  • Improved large-trade notifications with compact amounts, buy/sell indicators and quantity-weighted average prices for grouped trades. Initial snapshots and replayed trades remain quiet.
  • Show the currently selected wallet in the top-right account button as the first six and last four address characters; switching wallets updates the label.
  • Fixed SwiftLint issues required by the native release build.

The macOS installer supports Apple Silicon and Intel. This release uses the existing ad-hoc signing policy and is not Apple notarized.
